Name: A Slightly Bigger Farm
Author: LevelUpUltra
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is a mod that includes a slightly bigger standard farm map and comes in multiple variants![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download the zip file and extract it. Open the extracted folder and select one of 4 mod variant folders.
Then copy and paste it to the "Mods" folder located in your Stardew Valley game directory.

It is recommended to apply one of these mods before creating a new game. Applying one of them
to a pre-established game will result in incorrectly placed objects and buildings.

That said, it's still possible to apply them to a pre-established game as long as you're willing to put in the effort to
move everything you've placed on the map prior. If this sounds like you, then have fun! I recommend downloading
the - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url] - mod to help speed up the process, as well as the - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7834]Moveable Mailbox[/url] - mod which may be necessary.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod includes 4 different map variants![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]The Untidy & Quenched Edition[/b]
- A Map that is Filled with Grass, Weeds, Trees, Sticks, Stumps, Logs, Rocks and Boulders [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Includes a Small Pond

[b]The Untidy & Parched Edition[/b]
- A Map that is Filled with Grass, Weeds, Trees, Sticks, Stumps, Logs, Rocks and Boulders[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Does not include a Small Pond

[b]The Tidy & Quenched Edition[/b]
- A Map that is Mostly Empty, Except for a Small Amount of Randomly Generated Weeds, Trees, Grass, Sticks and Rocks[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Includes a Small Pond

[b]The Tidy & Parched Edition[/b]
- A Map that is Mostly Empty, Except for a Small Amount of Randomly Generated Weeds, Trees, Grass, Sticks and Rocks [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Does not include a Small Pond[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] - Stardew Modding API[/color]
